fusions.name: Raptor's Fall
fusions.desc: Whips the tip down on an enemy up to 9 tiles away, which deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Downdraught
fusions.desc: Beats the lash through a cone with a gust that deals 12 damage to everything within 4 tiles and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Thermal and Tether
fusions.desc: Swings you 6 tiles forward on the lash, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: Slipstream
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
